summary: Novo Nordisk filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a company announcement disclosing share transactions by insiders under Article 19 of the EU Market Abuse Regulation (the US equivalent of a Section 16 insider-transaction disclosure). Chief Scientific Officer Martin Holst Lange reported the sale of 12,000 Novo Nordisk B shares at DKK 285.00, an aggregate of DKK 3,420,000, executed on 2026-11-04 on Nasdaq Copenhagen. No board recommendation, advisor, stake, price-per-share deal terms, or structural mechanics are implicated; this is an ordinary insider-trading notification, not a special situation.
